description: This file defines the ClaimAttachmentController class, which handles HTTP requests related to claim attachment files within the OrangeHRM Claim plugin. Its main function processes incoming requests to retrieve and serve claim attachment files, performing validation and authorization checks.

classes.name: ClaimAttachmentController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling HTTP requests to retrieve claim attachment files, including validation, authorization, and setting response headers.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming HTTP requests to fetch and return the specified claim attachment file, performing necessary validation, authorization, and response preparation.
